q1_issues.issue: (Degree sk_raid_group_1 simultaneous "almost") puts a double-quoted string in the level slot, where the instruction set's Degree level is a bare lemmatized symbol (very, excessive); only QuantifierPhrase / CardinalityPhrase take quoted surface words.

"almost simultaneous" is encoded as the positive (Member sk_raid_group_1 simultaneous) plus a Degree tag, but "almost" withholds rather than intensifies the property, so the parse asserts what the text stops short of.

q2_gaps: Approximators ("almost", "nearly", "virtually") on an adjective — Degree is defined for intensifiers/downtoners that entail the positive property, and nothing carries a modifier that cancels it.

A distributed part-whole between two groups ("the bodies of seven of the bombers") — PartOf is defined for a component of an object or a member of a group, not for a group of parts standing one-to-one against another group.
notes: The partitive (definite 14-bomber superset, 7-member subset with SubsetOf and both Cardinality atoms), the sealed non-factive report with definite groups projected, the correctly suppressed past-perfect ordering across the seal boundary, and "Friday night" as Weekday plus day-part are all right per the instruction set.
